schedule: 132 Adam updates per state, identical existing seed-specific schedule:66 natural alternating66 task updates; both task endpoints averaged. Learning rate and all defaults unchanged. Normalize decoder columns after each update.
initialization: Same historical M36 hard-block-trained state per seed, copied into both maps; this is matched adaptation, not from-scratch architectural comparison.
objective: Natural full-output KL; task intact KL plus fixed weight times family/site-balanced encoded-change response error. No map-specific recalibration, gain fit or threshold detach.
retention: All four final states and initial references retained. No loss-based selection, extra steps or optimizer tuning.
replay: Rerun hard models and compare final parameters to historical M69 hard block states. Record nonexact differences rather than claiming replay without checking.
limitations: Same initial parameters need not mean same initial function or optimization difficulty. Continuous shrinkage alters amplitudes; fixed weight is a common objective, not equal initial gradient scale.
